The main takeaway from our work is that
the current state-of-the-art is insufficient for the risk assessment of MNs and needs to be improved by a more holistic approach, including in vivo, in vitro and abiotic assays.

the use of in vitro and in silico methods for grouping and extrapolation of MNs should be based on a thorough knowledge of the intrinsic and extrinsic properties of the MNs, as well as the biological/toxicokinetic and toxicodynamic properties of MNs.
there is no single method to assess in vivo effects of MNs, but rather an array of methods and approaches that can be used for different aspects and questions.
